Subject: Insurance evidence & Addl Insured — next steps

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our procurement checklist, we need:
- Certificate of insurance showing limits per the MSA (GL $2M, Cyber $1M, Auto as applicable)
- Additional Insured endorsement naming Starlabs Inc. and its affiliates
- Waiver of subrogation for GL where permissible

Our broker (cc'd) can pull the documents, but legal asked whether Redwood will accept a pending endorsement (binder + COI now, endorsement to follow within 14 days). Also: the order form currently references "insurance in accordance with Exhibit A" — please confirm Exhibit A will reflect the minimums above.

Can your team confirm acceptance of a pending endorsement workflow and an estimate for when the executed order form will be returned?

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Senior Contracts Manager
Starlabs Inc.

Attachments: none referenced in this message

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Insurance evidence & Addl Insured — next steps

Hi Elaine — thanks, and nice talking earlier. Quick answers:
1) Pending endorsement: We can accept a binder + COI now and a follow-up endorsement within 14 days as long as the COI references the pending endorsement and the broker confirms carrier commitment. We'll need the endorsement text (or a confirmed timeline) for our risk team review.
2) Exhibit A: we'll update the Order Form/Exhibit A to call out the specific coverage minimums you listed. I will loop in Legal for a short redline on the endorsement language.

Next steps I propose:
- OakBridge to provide COI + binder (if available) today
- Kimberly to provide redline endorsement language and confirm any disallowed waivers
- David to pull the Order Form from DocuSign and prepare updated Exhibit A for signature

I attached a short checklist for our procurement team with what we need on the COI and endorsement.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad

Team / Elaine,

I've uploaded a short redline (attached) to the endorsement language and called out two items the carrier must confirm:
1) Additional Insured: endorsement must name "Starlabs Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates" as additional insureds for ongoing operations and products/completed operations for the duration of the MSA.
2) Waiver of Subrogation: acceptable for GL but we require carrier acknowledgment that waiver does not void coverage where prohibited by law.

I also recommend adding a single-sentence acceptance clause to the Order Form: "Supplier shall provide evidence of insurance (COI and endorsement) as set forth in Exhibit A; a binder or COI referencing a pending endorsement is acceptable provided the final endorsement is delivered within 14 days of execution."
